quiz.prompt: Die Gezeiten are caused mainly by…

goodToKnow: Die Gezeiten (plural only) are the tides: Ebbe (low tide) und Flut (high tide), driven mainly by the moon. On Germany's North Sea coast the tides expose the Wattenmeer, a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2009, where people go on Wattwanderungen (mudflat hikes). The Baltic Sea has almost no tides. Das Gezeitenkraftwerk is a tidal power station.
